create.name: Pam Allen-LeBlanc
create.bio:
Pam Allen-LeBlanc is a Reiki Master Teacher licensed by the International Center for Reiki Training, working from Hidden Brook Farm outside Fredericton in New Brunswick, Canada, under the name Reiki from the Farm. She came to Reiki after years in corporate and government jobs, with a degree in agricultural science and an MBA behind her, and she now teaches it full time. She co-wrote the centre's Animal Reiki course and is the author of The Reiki Business Book, written for practitioners who want to make a living from their practice.

Her classes follow the Usui and Holy Fire III system taught by William Lee Rand's centre, from Level 1 and 2 through Reiki Master and Karuna Reiki Master, and she also teaches Animal Reiki and animal communication. Classes run on the farm and online across several time zones, alongside private sessions and a monthly online Reiki share. On her YouTube channel and podcast, Reiki from the Farm, she talks with Reiki teachers about the history of the practice, its Japanese roots, psychic and animal Reiki, and seasonal practice.

courses.title: ICRT Licensed Usui/Holy Fire III Reiki Level 1&2 Class (online, January 2027)
courses.description: A two-day online class on Eastern time covering the first two levels of Usui and Holy Fire III Reiki. Students receive placements, practise hands-on and distance Reiki, learn the symbols and get the centre's manual and a certificate.

courses.title: ICRT Licensed Usui/Holy Fire III Reiki Master Class (online evenings, January 2027)
courses.description: Master-level Reiki training over four evenings on Eastern time, for people who finished Levels 1 and 2 at least six months earlier. It prepares students to practise at the master level and to teach.

courses.title: ICRT Animal Reiki classes
courses.description: Animal Reiki at Level 1 and 2 and at master level, from the course she co-wrote for the International Center for Reiki Training. Students learn to offer Reiki to animals; earlier Usui training is required.

courses.title: Reiki and animal communication sessions
courses.description: Private Reiki sessions and animal communication sessions with Pam, booked through her site. A free short consultation call is also offered.

free_resources.title: Reiki from the Farm podcast
free_resources.description: Her free weekly podcast of conversations with Reiki teachers and practitioners about Reiki history, practice and teaching. Episodes are also posted on her YouTube channel.
